test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A certain sum amounts to Rs. 8,330 in 2(1)/(2) years and to Rs. 10,166 in 5(1)/(2) years at a certain rate per cent per annum, both at simple interest. What will be the simple interest (in Rs.) on the same sum in 4 years at double the rate?
solution:
**Given: **

Case(1) - Amount = 8330, Time = 2.5 Years

Case(2) - Amount = 10166, Time = 5.5 Years

**Formula used:**

A = P + SI

SI = (P× r × t)/100

**Calculation:**

Case (1)- 

⇒ 8330 = P + ( P × r × 2.5)/100

⇒ 8330 = P[1 + (r × 2.5)/100] ...(i)

Case (2)-

⇒ 10166 = P[1 + (r × 5.5)/100] ...(ii)

Apply Eqn (i)/(ii)

⇒ 8330/10166 = large{([1 + frac{2.5× r)/(100)]}{[1 + (5.5× r)/(100)]}} 

⇒ 0.8194 [100 + 5.5r] = [100 + 2.5r]

⇒ 81.94 + 4.5r = 100 + 2.5r

⇒ 2r = 18.06

⇒ **r = 9%**

From eqn (i)

⇒ 8330 = P [100 + 9 × 2.5]/100

⇒ P = 8330 ×100/122.5

⇒**P = Rs. 6800 **

Now acc. to Question-

R = 2r = 18%, t = 4 Years

SI = (P × R × t)/100

⇒ (6800 ×18 × 4)/100

⇒ **Rs 4896**** **

∴ S.I. for 2large{(1)/(2)} years = 612 × 2.5 = Rs. 1530

∴ Principal for 2large{(1)/(2)} years = A - SI = 8330 - 1530

Principal(P) = Rs.6800

S.I. for 2large{(1)/(2)} years = 1530 = (6800 × R × 2large{(1)/(2)})/100

∴ R = large{(1530 × 200)/(6800 × 5)}

R = 9%

According to question,

T = 4 years, r = 2R = 18%

S.I. = (6800 × 18 × 4)/100

S.I. = Rs.4896

∴ **Required S.I. is Rs.4896.**
